mapper.update: update attach_executor set executor_type = #{executorType}, hostname = #{hostname}, endpoint = #{endpoint}, status = #{status}, executor_version = #{executorVersion}, capabilities_json = #{capabilitiesJson}, last_heartbeat_at = #{lastHeartbeatAt}, lease_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select * from instance where process_start_id = #{processStartId} limit 1
mapper.update: update instance set application_id = #{applicationId}, environment_id = coalesce(#{environmentId}, environment_id), hostname = #{hostname}, process_id = #{processId}, runtime = #{runtime}, status = case when coalesce(#{environmentId}, environment_id) is null then 'PENDING_ASSIGNMENT' else 'ACTIVE' end, last_seen_at = #{lastSeenAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, java_version = #{javaVersion}, capabilities_json = #{capabilitiesJson}, lease_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt}, registration_status = case when coalesce(#{environmentId}, environment_id) is null then 'PENDING_ASSIGNMENT' else 'ASSIGNED' end where id = #{id}

update sidecar_instance set status = 'ACTIVE', executor_id = #{executorId}, sidecar_version = #{sidecarVersion}, endpoint = #{endpoint}, capabilities_json = #{capabilitiesJson}, last_heartbeat_at = #{lastHeartbeatAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into attach_executor_target( executor_id, instance_id, process_id, agent_jar, runtime, java_version, status, capabilities_json, last_seen_at, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{executorId}, #{instanceId}, #{processId}, #{agentJar}, #{runtime}, #{javaVersion}, #{status}, #{capabilitiesJson}, #{lastSeenAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) on conflict (executor_id, instance_id) do update set process_id = excluded.process_id, agent_jar = excluded.agent_jar, runtime = excluded.runtime, java_version = excluded.java_version, status = excluded.status, capabilities_json = excluded.capabilities_json, last_seen_at = excluded.last_seen_at, updated_at = excluded.updated_at
mapper.select: select count(*) from agent_instance a where a.instance_id = #{instanceId} and a.status in ('ACTIVE', 'ONLINE') and (a.lease_expires_at is null or a.lease_expires_at > #{now})
mapper.update: update sidecar_instance s set status = 'OFFLINE', updated_at = #{updatedAt} where s.executor_id = #{executorId} and s.status in ('ACTIVE', 'ONLINE') and exists ( select 1 from attach_executor_target t where t.executor_id = s.executor_id and t.instance_id = s.instance_id and t.status = 'OFFLINE' )
